citation: Karkoschka (2003), Sizes, shapes, and albedos of the inner satellites of Neptune, Icarus 162,400–407
orientation: Synchronous long axis toward Neptune, with IAU Galatea pole and prime meridian from pck00011; orientation is an assumed ellipsoid alignment, not a detailed shape solution.
qualification: Published triaxial fit to Voyager images; smooth interpolation represents the measured axes, not terrain. The PCK BODY806 79 km spherical radius is older and is not used for dimensions.
